axes: glTF Y-up. Blender (x, y, z) = glTF (x, z, -y). Module front/exterior faces glTF +Z.

attach.tile: Origin at tile centre; y=0 is the level base (floors) or ground (terrain, roads).
attach.edge: Origin at the tile-edge midpoint at the level base; runs along X; exterior faces +Z.
attach.vertex: Origin on the grid vertex; an outer corner fills the -X/+Z quadrant.
attach.roof: Origin at the footprint centre at the wall top (the next level's elevation).
attach.free: Origin at base centre; wall-mounted items have the wall face at z=0 and project toward +Z.
